scope: Exact unconditioned fixed-location weighted Gaussian law, exponential integrability, and Eq. (51), with the independently refined source topology below. This is not proof, integration, or publication acceptance.
accepted_signature:
theorem weightedRadialLevels_gaussian_mgf (n : ℕ+) (h : ℕ)
    (β : Fin (h + 1) → ℝ)
    (x : Fin (h + 1) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n.val)) :
    let L := Fin (h + 1)
    let P := {p : Fin (2 ^ (64 * (h + 1)) + 1) // Even p.val ∧ 4 ≤ p.val}
    let B := L × P
    let C := fun b : B ↦
      ((Fin b.2.val.val × (Σ j : Fin (h - b.1.val + 1),
        Fin ((2 ^ (74 * (h + 1))) ^ j.val))) → Fin n.val)
    let E := fun b : B ↦ EuclideanSpace ℝ (C b)
    let degree := fun p : P ↦
      (⟨p.val.val, p.property.1, p.property.2, Nat.le_of_lt_succ p.val.isLt⟩ :
        {p : ℕ // Even p ∧ 4 ≤ p ∧ p ≤ 2 ^ (64 * (h + 1))})
    let S := fun i : L ↦ ∑ j : Fin (h - i.val + 1), (2 ^ (74 * (h + 1))) ^ j.val
    let a := fun (i : L) (p : P) ↦ 1 / ((p.val.val : ℝ) ^ 4 * (S i : ℝ) ^ 2 *
      Real.sqrt ((h - i.val + 1 : ℕ) * Real.log (2 * (2 : ℝ) ^ (64 * (h + 1)) * S i)))
    let χ := fun r : ℝ ↦
      expNegInvGlue (r - 13 / 20) /
        (expNegInvGlue (r - 13 / 20) + expNegInvGlue (7 / 10 - r)) *
      (expNegInvGlue (1 - r) /
        (expNegInvGlue (1 - r) + expNegInvGlue (r - 19 / 20)))
    let tail := fun (i : L) (j : Fin (h - i.val + 1)) ↦ x ⟨i.val + j.val, by omega⟩
    let c := fun i : L ↦ ∏ j, χ (‖tail i j‖ / Real.sqrt n.val)
    let field := fun (i : L) (z : (p : P) → E (i, p)) ↦
      if ∃ j, tail i j = 0 then 0 else
        c i * ∑ p : P, angularDegreeComponent n h i (degree p)
          (fun j ↦ NormedSpace.normalize (tail i j)) (z p)
    let Ω := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Σ b : B, C b)
    let H := fun (ξ : Ω) (i : L) ↦ field i
      (fun p ↦ WithLp.toLp 2 (fun k : C (i, p) ↦ ξ ⟨(i, p), k⟩))
    let μ := stdGaussian Ω
    let W := fun ξ : Ω ↦ ∑ i : L, β i * H ξ i
    let V := (n.val : ℝ) * ∑ i : L, β i ^ 2 * (c i) ^ 2 * ∑ p : P, (a i p) ^ 2
    HasLaw W (gaussianReal 0 V.toNNReal) μ ∧
      Integrable (fun ξ ↦ Real.exp (-W ξ)) μ ∧
      (∫ ξ, Real.exp (-W ξ) ∂μ) = Real.exp (V / 2)

source.title: Towards the Query Complexity of Sampling under Strong Log-Concavity and Log-Sobolev Inequalities

TYPING: n is a positive block dimension, h is a natural depth, and x is one deterministic tuple of h+1 Euclidean n-vectors shared by all levels. The tail indexed by Fin(h-i+1) gives x_i,…,x_h inclusive.
β is one deterministic real scalar per level. No β_i depends on ξ. There is no additional measure, random x, random weight, or Gaussian-law witness among the public inputs.
STANDING: The source takes sufficiently large n and h=floor((log n)^(1/3)/32). Eq. (18) has β_0=η_*λ and β_i=η_*λ(∑_{j<i}D_j/β_j)⁻¹ with λ=λ_* /(h+1)^2 and D_i=C_g P^5 (h-i+1) sqrt(log(2P)) S_i^3 log(2PS_i)/ε_g. These positive deterministic weights instantiate β. The algebraic Gaussian identity does not require their recursion, signs, quantitative bounds, or the asymptotic n,h regime.
derived_not_assumed: The fixed-x coefficient maps are measurable (indeed linear), mutual independence of the relevant coefficient blocks, Gaussian law, exact variance nonnegativity, and exponential integrability. Unit directions follow from nonzero normalization; a zero tail is handled by the exact cutoff and source zero extension.

definition_audit.carrier: The finite pair subtype indexes (i,p) with 0≤i≤h and all even 4≤p≤P=2^(64(h+1)) inclusive. The coordinate type of block (i,p) assigns one of n values to each of p copies and each of the S_i=∑_{j=0}^{h-i} K^j ordered slots, with K=2^(74(h+1)). This is the ordered n^(pS_i)-entry tensor, not its symmetric quotient. The Euclidean space over the disjoint union realizes the full orthogonal direct sum. WithLp.toLp 2 retypes the actual block projection; all H_i use the same ξ∼stdGaussian Ω = μ_n.
definition_audit.field: Eq. (14) amplitude and Eq. (15) entrywise contraction appear unchanged, with sqrt(n) already in angularDegreeComponent. The deterministic factor c_i is exactly Eq. (16) with the footnote 2 glue and endpoints 0.65, 0.7, 0.95, 1; each glue denominator has at least one positive summand, and χ(0)=0. The chosen branch sets H_i to zero whenever any tail block vanishes and otherwise multiplies the angular degree sum by c_i. This is equivalent to summing the zero-extended H_i,p and not to an energy truncation, an earlier-gate product, or a load.
definition_audit.weighted_variance: W=∑_i β_i H_i and its centered Gaussian variance is exactly V=n∑_i β_i² C_i(x)² v_i, v_i=∑_p a_i,p². Squaring the deterministic scale gives β_i²; each independent degree contributes its own a_i,p², without covariance terms or squaring the sum of amplitudes. The outer factor is n, not sqrt(n), and V.toNNReal preserves V since all summands are nonnegative. A zero tail or zero cutoff yields zero contribution; zero weights are legal; zero total variance is the centered Dirac case, giving expectation one.
definition_audit.mgf: For the centered law, t=-1 makes the mean term vanish and contributes t²V/2=V/2. The integral is under μ_n over ξ only, not spatial γ_n. Explicit integrability excludes a totalized nonintegrable interpretation and is discharged by the finite Gaussian exponential moment, including variance zero.
